measures.name: paid_order_count_measure

measures.name: cancelled_order_count_measure

measures.name: refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: partial_refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: full_refund_order_count_measure

measures.name: payment_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: refund_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: net_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: gross_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: discount_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END

measures.name: refund_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END

measures.name: selling_store_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN store_id END

measures.name: valid_order_items_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END

measures.name: new_member_count_measure
measures.expr: member_id

measures.name: first_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN member_id END

measures.name: first_order_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN net_sales_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: first_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: repeat_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_rank >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: monthly_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: member_id

measures.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN monthly_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END

measures.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: member_id

measures.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: net_sales_cents

measures.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN monthly_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: 创建订单数
metrics.description: 按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号一次，包含取消单。

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.label: 支付订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后来全部退款的订单。

metrics.name: valid_order_count
metrics.label: 有效订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付减退款大于零的订单数；取消和全退不计。

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.label: 取消订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_count
metrics.label: 退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数，包括部分退款与全部退款。

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 部分退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款大于零、小于实付金额的订单数。

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 全额退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零、退款等于实付的订单数。

metrics.name: payment_cents
metrics.label: 实付金额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，尚未扣退款；单位分。

metrics.name: refund_cents
metrics.label: 退款金额
metrics.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属，不是现金退款发生日；单位分。

metrics.name: net_sales_cents
metrics.label: 净销售额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计；取消单不计；按原订单下单日期归属；单位分。

metrics.name: gross_cents
metrics.label: 支付订单原价金额
metrics.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计；单位分。

metrics.name: discount_cents
metrics.label: 优惠金额
metrics.description: paid 订单原价减实付的金额合计；退款不冲减原优惠金额；单位分。

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.label: 购买会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口及筛选条件内有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数，不做跨系统自然人去重。

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count
metrics.label: 退款会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: selling_store_count
metrics.label: 成交门店数
metrics.description: 窗口内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。

metrics.name: valid_order_items
metrics.label: 有效订单商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计；退款金额不能推算退货件数，此项不是净商品销量。

metrics.name: avg_order_value
metrics.label: 有效订单均额
metrics.description: 净销售额除以有效订单数，单位分／单。

metrics.name: avg_buyer_value
metrics.label: 购买会员人均消费
metrics.description: 净销售额除以购买会员数，单位分／账户。

metrics.name: purchase_frequency
metrics.label: 购买频次
metrics.description: 有效订单数除以购买会员数，单位单／账户。

metrics.name: refund_amount_rate
metrics.label: 退款金额占比
metrics.description: 退款金额除以实付金额。

metrics.name: cancel_rate
metrics.label: 取消率
metrics.description: 取消订单数除以创建订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_rate
metrics.label: 退款订单率
metrics.description: 退款订单数除以支付订单数。

metrics.name: discount_rate
metrics.label: 优惠率
metrics.description: 优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额。

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.label: 单均商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数。

metrics.name: new_member_count
metrics.label: 注册会员数
metrics.description: 按注册日期统计新注册 CRM 账户数；可按归属门店和会员等级分组，不等于自然人数。

metrics.name: first_buyer_count
metrics.label: 观测期首购会员数
metrics.description: 在测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入查询窗口的不同 CRM 账户数；先用全覆盖历史确定首次，再按窗口筛选。

metrics.name: first_order_sales_cents

metrics.name: first_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期首单数
metrics.description: 在全测试覆盖期内先为每个账户按日期、订单号排序，其第一笔有效订单落入窗口的单数。

metrics.name: repeat_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期后续购买订单数
metrics.description: 账户全测试覆盖期内第二笔及以后的有效订单，按订单日期落入窗口计数。不是月内复购人数。

metrics.name: monthly_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内购买会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内复购会员数

sources.quote: 自然月内有至少一笔有效订单、且月末符合总部运营月报付费资格的不同账户数。
本次付费会员的月度指标按自然月月底最后一天的资格判断。先选月末有资格的账户，再统计这些账户当月全渠道、全门店的有效订单；不要求每笔订单发生当天也已经具有资格。有效购买沿用本次财务邮件的订单规则。
本次六项指标均只支持完整自然月、全渠道和全门店；多月须按月分别列出，暂不按门店或渠道拆付费会员月报。付费资格的卡产品范围和有效状态请向运营与门店确认，不能从等级或付款金额猜测。
计入：悦享年卡、家庭季卡（MSG-04489）。
不计入：异业联名卡——即使收费也由合作方经营，不进本次自营会员范围（MSG-04489；理由为原话，未另作核实结论）。
不计入：体验卡，与购卡金额无关（MSG-04489；测试数据中 0、100、500 分的体验卡均不计入）。
付费资格判定不使用会员等级（普通、银卡、金卡），也不使用购卡支付金额（MSG-04489）。
判定日账户名下至少有一张悦享年卡或家庭季卡有效，该账户即有资格；同一账户即使有多张计入范围内的有效卡，也只算一个有资格账户，不按卡数重复算人（小林 MSG-04493、陈姐 MSG-04504）。多张有效卡不重复累计订单（陈姐 MSG-04504）。
卡在判定日 D 有效，当且仅当 生效日 ≤ D，且 D 早于计划到期日与提前终止日中较早的一个；提前终止为空时只看计划到期日，且不因此视为无限期。

constraints: 仅支持完整自然月、全渠道、全门店；多月须按月分别列出，暂不按门店或渠道拆付费会员月报。
付费资格按自然月月底最后一天判断：账户名下至少一张悦享年卡或家庭季卡在月末有效；异业联名卡、体验卡不计入；资格不按会员等级或购卡支付金额判断。

本次付费会员的月度指标按自然月月底最后一天的资格判断。先选月末有资格的账户，再统计这些账户当月全渠道、全门店的有效订单；不要求每笔订单发生当天也已经具有资格。有效购买沿用本次财务邮件的订单规则。

model_sql.member_month_valid_orders: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS DATE) AS activity_date FROM {{ ref('orders') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0), member_month_counts AS (SELECT member_id, activity_date, COUNT(*) AS monthly_order_count FROM valid_orders GROUP BY member_id, activity_date) SELECT v.order_id, v.member_id, v.activity_date, c.monthly_order_count FROM valid_orders v JOIN member_month_counts c ON c.member_id = v.member_id AND c.activity_date = v.activity_date
model_sql.paid_member_month_orders: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS DATE) AS activity_date, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE) AS month_end, paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_sales_cents FROM {{ ref('orders') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0), qualified_member_month AS (SELECT DISTINCT v.member_id, v.activity_date FROM valid_orders v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('cards') }} c WHERE c.member_id = v.member_id AND c.card_type IN ('悦享年卡', '家庭季卡') AND c.valid_from <= v.month_end AND v.month_end < c.valid_until AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR v.month_end < c.ended_at))), paid_orders AS (SELECT v.order_id, v.member_id, v.activity_date, v.net_sales_cents FROM valid_orders v JOIN qualified_member_month q ON q.member_id = v.member_id AND q.activity_date = v.activity_date), member_month_counts AS (SELECT member_id, activity_date, COUNT(*) AS monthly_order_count FROM paid_orders GROUP BY member_id, activity_date) SELECT p.order_id, p.member_id, p.activity_date, p.net_sales_cents, c.monthly_order_count FROM paid_orders p JOIN member_month_counts c ON c.member_id = p.member_id AND c.activity_date = p.activity_date
model_sql.valid_member_orders_ranked: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at, paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_sales_cents FROM {{ ref('orders') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0), ranked AS (SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at, net_sales_cents, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id) AS order_rank FROM valid_orders) SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at, net_sales_cents, order_rank FROM ranked
